final_table.configuration: ORACLE (perfect chooser over the candidates that exist)
CURRENT SUTRA (rule over the shipped candidate set)
BEST FULL PIPELINE (warm -> cold, S-VAL temporal holdout, trace-tail coordinates)

coordinate_policy.rule: the coordinate of an ingested visit is the component-wise median of the last 3 fixes of its official track; the raw check-in sample is retained as provenance

frozen_configuration.ranker: rule priority (learned challengers rejected: see selection study)

place_neighbour_gate.construction: median of promoted pre-as-of evidence from OTHER addresses in the same official place block; licence official; provenance = contributing observations; independence = neighbour addresses only
place_neighbour_gate.gate: LOCKED — measurable, but it does not beat the cold rule on the same rows, so the C2 admission bar is not cleared and the arm stays disabled

script_bridge.verdict: rejected — the induced lexicon resolves those rows but does not move them closer to the truth (the pincode path already does the job)

sealed_s_eval.disclosure: the S-Eval truth was read once, after the configuration was frozen; the per-address outcome is persisted in this receipt so a later run of the same configuration cannot read it again
